title: Tuning the drum and moving the snares to change the animal sound
summary: He tunes the drum higher, shifts the snares by thumb to go lower for a lion or higher for a chicken, and keeps playing with sticks throughout.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
